summary: Marketing is in execution mode, with the knowledge website redesign, SEO prioritization of Asia Star and Intelligent China, and the upcoming Tech In Asia event as the key live initiatives.
summaryDetail: The most pressing work is the knowledge website redesign, where the team has reviewed initial mockups and is awaiting specific feedback from Joseph, Julie, and the speaker, with Joseph to share his HTML file to facilitate further iteration. Concurrently, SEO strategy is being refined, prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China programs, with Joseph tasked to draft target areas/prompts and get a conversion tracking brief, while the team analyzes existing participants to define target audiences. For the Tech In Asia event on Aug 21, LIU Xuan is handling logistics (F&B, KV feedback, Dean's topics) and must confirm details by Aug 21, while also coordinating the Aug 25 event and Brazilian delegation visit. Additionally, content updates are in progress: Joseph is reworking the Worldwide Locations sub-heading, adding campus photos, and incorporating amendments to the Indonesia program page for public launch. This week, the focus is on delivering feedback on the redesign, finalizing SEO drafts, and ensuring all Tech In Asia logistics are confirmed.
